name: Wingman 103 wearable RF detector (MyDefence)
description: Body-worn passive RF detector for dismounted troops. Up to 6 km on the drone or controller link, direction finding to within 30 deg, alert in under 10 s. 90 deg face as issued; omnidirectional with the wideband antenna. ATAK compatible.

detectRangeM.condition: up to 6000 m, no target class stated

classifyRangeM.condition: protocol identification range — No separate classification range is published. Datasheet claims an 'EXTENSIVE DRONE LIBRARY - Enables accurate classification and low false positives'; library matching in a passive receiver occurs at detection, so classify range is set equal to detect range. INFERRED, not stated.
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 6000 m at INFERRED REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: 90 deg horizontal as issued; 360 deg with the wideband antenna

elevationDeg.condition: elevation coverage — Datasheet gives 'Vertical 90 deg' as a beamwidth, not as a min/max elevation pair. Converting it to [-45, 45] would assume a horizontal boresight the datasheet never states, so the field stays null.
elevationDeg.note: Inventory records null deg (90 deg (vertical beamwidth)) at UNKNOWN L3; the seed leaves the field null

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single-site RF direction finder measures bearing, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.condition: signal-strength direction-finding mode, ±30° (vendor bound taken as 1 sigma)
azimuthAccuracyDeg.source: MyDefence Wingman product page and Wingman 103/105 datasheet: 'direction finding with ±30° accuracy'
azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: A body-worn signal-strength bearing, not an interferometric DF; the figure is a sector indication and sits far above the RF class.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Two-dimensional RF direction finding gives no elevation; not established by the public record.

receiverSensitivityDbm.note: Planning factor, 2.4 GHz band, channel-integrated: kTB for a 10 MHz OcuSync-class channel (-104 dBm) plus a 12 dB receiver noise figure (Narda SignalShark C-UAS application note) gives -92 dBm, recorded as -90 dBm. The MyDefence Wingman 103/105 sheet gives bands (2.4, 5.2, 5.8 GHz internal; 350 to 1300 MHz and 5 to 6 GHz with the wideband antenna) and 'up to 6 km' but no sensitivity.

geolocationMinNodes.note: Signal-strength direction finding to ±30° by sweeping the 90° internal antenna (MyDefence Wingman 103/105 sheet); bearing only, no multi-node geolocation documented, so no node count applies.

rfBands.value: 2.4, 5.2 and 5.8 GHz as issued; 5.2 GHz has no band code
